alex.m: Quick Q — we approved a promo for an Ireland hire effective Jan 20 but packet arrived after payroll cutoff. Do we do off-cycle?
people-ops: Generally include on next scheduled payroll if backdate <= 90 days. Off-cycle only if vendor requires it or backdate > 90 days.
alex.m: Manager only signed — do we need manager's manager?
people-ops: Yes. Payroll requires timestamped mgr + mgr's mgr approvals in Lattice for retro. If missing, have manager add a timestamped approval comment.
comp-ops: If the promotion changes equity or bonus targets, loop comp-ops before payroll. Equity paperwork can delay processing.
payroll-bot: payroll-bot: Use subject 'Retro Request: [Last, First] - [Country]'. Attach signed packet PDF, Lattice link, payroll ID and local tax ID (PPS for Ireland). Add header 'BACKDATE' if > 30 days. Intake closes 24h before run.
alex.m: Thanks — I'll get mm signoff and email payroll with subject 'Retro Request: Nolan, Ciara - Ireland' and include PPS. :thumbsup:
